verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_clean_html_unchanged: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Good docstrings, named constants and dataclasses (AttrToken, StartTagToken). But the tokenizer and helpers use single-letter names in core logic, e.g. `k`, `n`, `q` in parse_html5_start_tag and `s`, `m` in decode_css_escapes, which caps this at accept.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A single new 1199-line file. sanitize_html_once is a very long branching tokenizer loop (steps 1–7, 6a–6f) well over 100 lines. parse_html5_start_tag repeats the AttrToken append/sep_start pattern about 8 times. The bs4 danger check is duplicated in has_bs4_danger and sanitize_html.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Explicit encodings with a latin-1 fallback are good. But has_bs4_danger has `except Exception: return False`, which silently treats a parse failure as safe. Magic numbers (max_iters=5, range(10), range(5)). main exits 1 with no usage message.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: Uses general rules rather than literal strings: clean_identifier strips control/whitespace characters and lowercases names; full_unescape plus normalize_for_url_check before scheme checks; on* attributes dropped by prefix; deny sets for script/object/embed/base/animate; checks for meta/link/style/svg use href; the agent verified 64 payloads in Chromium.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: Edits are mostly surgical on the original token offsets, so formatting is preserved. But the hidden test_clean_html_unchanged failed, so benign markup gets altered. Heuristics drop whole unclosed rawtext/media tags, and the bs4 fallback re-serialises the whole document with str(soup).
